thread:
anya: Heads-up: marlin-q (int8->int4 progressive quant) canary shows C0 control bytes embedded inside JSON arrays for streaming funcalls. Failing in ~0.9% of calls when prefix_cache + microbatching enabled.

sam: do we have a concrete failing snippet?

anya: yes — observed assembled stream:```
{"tool":"rank","args":{"items":["x","y","z"]}}
```
but downstream consumer got:```
{"tool":"rank","args":{"items":["x","y" ,"z"]}}
```
(note 0x03 inserted before "y"; parser accepted but app logic treating strings with control chars as invalid).

hadi: 0x03 is ETX. Weird that parser doesn't reject; our schema-lint allows control chars inside strings but downstream tool validation is stricter. Is this only on marlin-q?

anya: mirrored fp16/int8-stable don't show it. Canary run shows spike.

c anary-bot: canary-5823456789 started on marlin-q-canary-07 at 05:10 UTC. metrics: control_in_string_rate=0.92% (baseline 0.01%).

nina: quick triage: (1) capture raw token-id trace and pre-utf8 bytes, (2) run kvcache-off mirror, (3) add tiny sanitizer that removes C0 bytes inside strings before schema-lint for opted-in customers only.

sam: agree on steps. Also add telemetry tag `string_control_sanitized` if sanitizer applied. Keep canaries strict.

anya: pasted raw bytes around offending spot:```
... 0x22 0x78 0x22 0x2c 0x03 0x22 0x79 0x22 0x2c 0x22 0x7a 0x22 ...
```
shows 0x03 slipped in between the comma and quote.

hadi: that suggests a token-to-byte mapping or concat padding issue; if a token maps to 0x03 under the new quant table then it might leak during prefix stitch. Run a roundtrip token->byte check for marlin-q vs stable.

nina: kicked kvcache-off mirror. will also enable token-id dumps for 20 failing samples and upload to ML-ONBOARD-9999.

canary-bot: mirror job canary-5823456789/prefix-off launched at 05:18 UTC.

sam: if kvcache-off fixes it then batch/prefix join is suspect. If not, tokenmap or packer. Add a fuzz that injects low-value bytes at joins for marlin-q to reproduce.

anya: quick interim: enabled sanitizer on a small opt-in tenant -> control_in_string_rate dropped to 0.04%. Good for customers but we need root fix.

hadi: I'll add a unit in the fragment-assembler that asserts no control bytes are inserted between tokens when joining prefix+live fragments. Also add tokenmap roundtrip test in kernel CI.

nina: kvcache-off result: parse_fail_rate 0.02%. That strongly implicates prefix concat.

sam: next: (A) defensive trim of C0-range bytes at fragment boundaries behind a feature flag (hadi), (B) unit+fuzz tests (hadi & nina), (C) bisect recent marlin-q tokenmap/packer commits (sam).

anya: filing ML-ONBOARD-9999 and attaching failing dumps + tenant id. PR for sanitizer going up now.

hadi: PR for defensive assembler coming in with flag. Will also ensure test to preserve user bytes (we only drop if byte is <=0x1f and adjacent boundary looks like pad).

sam: I'll bisect tomorrow morning across last 6 commits touching tokenmap/packer and prefix stitching. Ping me if you want to pair. :thumbsup:

nina: adding CI job `marlin-q-join-fuzz` to inject control bytes and check assembler behavior.

anya: thanks all. keeping canary strict until we have kernel/assembler patch. Will update thread when bisect completes.
